name: Media Orange Logic
description: Integrates the Orange Logic (Cortex) DAM with Drupal media via an entity browser widget and media source.
project_description:
Search your Orange Logic DAM inside of your Drupal Media Library.

Directly add the remote Media to your Drupal Media Library and use it inside of Drupal.

 Features: 

 
 Supports images, audio, video 
 Advanced search of media entities 
 Entity browser intergration (Media library is partially supported, see below) 
 
 Configuration: 

 
 API domain/entrypoint 
 authentification (username, password) 
 
 Upd: Media library support 

 Media library support is added. Only image media type is supported yet by orange logic media library widget.

 Check README for details.
